subject: english
question:
**Direction: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.**

Suspicion
solution: The correct answer is **"Conviction."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Suspicion"** means a feeling of doubt or mistrust towards someone or something. (संदेह, शक (यह भावना या धारणा कि दाल में कुछ काला है)) • **Example**: *She was arrested on **suspicion**__ of murder.* • **"Conviction"** means a strong belief or opinion about something. (न्‍यायालय द्वारा अपराधी ठहराए जाने की क्रिया; दोषसिद्धि) __ • **Example**:* **He has several previous **convictions**__ for burglary.* • **Conviction** is the opposite of **suspicion** as it is a positive belief, while **suspicion **is a negative doubt. • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Niggle:** a small doubt or worry. (एक छोटा सा संदेह या चिंता) • **Tremor: **a slight shaking movement. (हलका कंपन) • **Incertitude: **a state of uncertainty or hesitation. (अनिश्चितता या झिझक की स्थिति) 3c:T980, The correct answer is** "Losare."**
